title: Chapter 405: Monster Mountain Range
content:
Chapter 405: Monster Mountain Range

When Hadro saw this equipment blueprint, he was so surprised that his jaw dropped.

Seeing that Wang Shuo had reached the level of an intermediate general, he was even more in awe.

"Prefect Wang, I'm afraid I can't provide these materials."

Hadro shook his head. With his ability, he couldn't get these things.

But he seemed to have thought of something, and said: "Prefect Wang, I heard that in our Li Chamber of Commerce, there will be an auction recently, and a teleportation token will be auctioned, which can go to the Warcraft Mountains in the Void Battlefield, where there is There are a lot of monsters, and it’s a good place to produce high-level materials.”

When Wang Shuo heard this, a look of surprise appeared on his face.

Is there such a place?

"How many energy crystals do you estimate will be needed to get the teleportation order?"

Hadro thought for a while and said: "It is estimated that it will not be less than 5 million, and no more than 10 million at most."

Wang Shuo took a breath of cold air. Is a token to enter a certain dungeon so valuable?

"Wang Commandery, the Warcraft Mountain Range is not an ordinary dungeon. There are not only a large number of rare treasures there, but it is also a good place to improve your strength. However, it is also very dangerous. If you are not careful, you will fall."

Wang Shuo thought about it for a while, and it would still take a few months for Dahuai Territory to be completely connected to the outside world.

Now that I am worried that there is nothing to do, the Warcraft Mountains is a good place to go.

So I asked Hadro to take a photo of the teleportation order.

Wang Shuo paid 5 million energy crystals in advance as a deposit.

A few days later, Hadro took the transmission order and handed it to Wang Shuo, spending a total of eight million energy crystals.

Transaction completed.

Wang Shuo looked at the transmission order in his hand and seemed to have a familiar feeling.

He hurriedly rummaged through his body and found an identical teleportation order.

After thinking about it carefully, I found that this token was obtained by killing an undead warrior during the defensive battle of Shanhai City.

There was no warning text on the token. Wang Shuo did not check it carefully due to the emergency of the war, and later forgot about it.

Wang Shuo cried out in pain. If he had known the purpose of this token, there would be no need to spend eight million in unjust money.

Things have come to this, and that's all.

[Void Battlefield Warcraft Mountain Teleportation Order, each teleportation token can allow 5 people to enter. 】

This void battlefield looks very big. There were ancient battlefields before, and maybe there will be other places inside.

Wang Shuo was thoughtful.

It's better to bring a few more people in together to make it safer.

Wang Shuo thought for a while, went directly to Shanhai City and told Zhao Bonde the news.

Zhao Bangde called Zhu Dongheng, and the three discussed it for a while.

Zhu Dongheng is very interested in this matter.

In addition, Zhao Bangde also asked his four commanders to come over and asked about their wishes.

Among them, two commanders, Xie Xiaofeng and Ba Huoyao, expressed their willingness to go.

The remaining two commanders, Sauron and Xu Qikai, expressed their willingness to follow Zhao Bond and stay in Dahuai Territory.

After all, the base camp also needs some top experts to be in charge.

After Wang Shuo returned to the territory, he called Ayub, Gong Zheng, Gude, Ye Tianba, Lin Dabiao, and Gu Liji as candidates to enter the Warcraft Mountains this time.

During this period of time, there should be no large-scale wars in the Dahuai Territory.

Wang Shuo led his men to join Zhu Dongheng and the other three, and used the teleportation order to enter the Warcraft Mountains.

There was a flash of white light, and Wang Shuo and the other 10 people came to a world of ice and snow.

On the vast white snowfield, the wind is biting, and in the distance there are some snow-capped mountains towering into the clouds.

Wang Shuo stretched out his hand and caught a piece of snowflake, feeling a bit of coldness, but as a warrior, he was able to resist the coldness and would not be frozen.
